CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid templates for the open-source software made by BRF Tech.
**filex** - a self-hosted web file manager for local folders and S3, SFTP, WebDAV, FTP and SMB storage, with sharing, search, version history and encrypted folders. MIT licensed. Source: https://github.com/BRF-Tech/filex
Problems with an app go to the issue tracker of its own repository (filex: https://github.com/BRF-Tech/filex/issues). Problems with a template go to https://github.com/BRF-Tech/unraid-templates/issues.
